notes: Per the Oct 2026 JAMA usage study, 88% of emergency physicians' queries were about topics outside emergency medicine (the highest of any specialty). The OpenEvidence v. Doximity lawsuit settled: a settlement in principle was filed Oct 15, 2026 and the case was dismissed with prejudice on Oct 16, with each side paying its own costs; other terms were not disclosed.
